sentences.text:
Author: Rakesh Thapliyal
Bench: Rakesh Thapliyal
 Office Notes,
Sl. Date reports,
No. orders or Court'S Or Judge'S Order
S  proceedings  or directions  and  Registrar's  order with  Signatures  C482 No. 2152 of 2023  Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. Rohit Arora, learned counsel for the applicant.
2. Mr. Saurabh Pandey, learned Brief Holder for the State.
3. Mr. Naitik Bhatt, learned counsel for the complainant.

4. The Co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 03.11.2023, has directed the State Counsel to give the name of the expert of the sign language in order to examine whether the parties specially wife (respondent no. 2) who is deaf and dumb since birth want to enter into compromise and is ready to compound the offences against the applicant.

Thereafter, Mr. Saurabh Pandey, learned Brief Holder informed this Court that one Mohd. Shakir, a sign language expert gave his concurrence to assist the Court who was directed by order dated 06.11.2023, to present in the Court for assistance but, today the sign language expert Mohd. Shakir is not present.

In that eventuality,
let State file the objection to the compounding application and the sign language expert Mohd.
Shakir may also be present on the date fixed.
5. Present applicant is the husband of the complainant-respondent no. 2 and both are present in the Court with their minor child.

Father of both the applicant and respondent no. 2 are also present in the Court and undertakes before the Court that the applicant is ready to bring his wife- respondent no. 2 and they will reside happily with the minor child.
5. Applicant-Amit Kumar Soni, complainant-Neetu Verma (wife of the applicant) and their father are duly identified by their counsel.
Xerox copies of the Aadhar card signed by the parties themselves and attested by their respective learned counsel are filed and kept on record.

6. Put up this matter on 02.01.2024.
C482/2152/2023 on 9 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/72906323/
1 7.

The further proceedings of Criminal Case No. 132 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323, 504 and 506 IPC pending in the court of learned Judicial Magistrate, Kichha, District Udham Singh Nagar shall remain stayed until further orders of the Court.
